page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g5ne.16xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance hosted on the KVM hypervisor. Powered by x86_64 architecture Intel Xeon 8163 processors operating at a base frequency of 2.5 GHz, this instance features 64 dedicated vCPUs and 256 GB of RAM, maintaining a standard 1:4 vCPU-to-memory allocation ratio of 4 GB per vCPU.

The instance operates without integrated GPUs or local NVMe storage, relying entirely on network-attached block storage for persistence. Network infrastructure supports up to 30 Gbps of baseline network bandwidth, accommodating sustained network traffic for distributed application nodes.

From a resource density perspective, the high vCPU and RAM capacity provides enterprise consolidation efficiency for large-scale microservice platforms, web serving arrays, and batch processing systems. Workloads requiring local high-speed SSD throughput are constrained by the reliance on remote block storage, shifting I/O performance dependence to cloud disk attachments.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g5ne.16xlarge is a general-purpose instance built on x86_64 architecture using the KVM hypervisor. The instance is equipped with 64 dedicated vCPUs driven by Intel Xeon 8163 processors running at 2.5 GHz, coupled with 256 GB of RAM. This provides a balanced memory profile of 4.0 GB per vCPU. The server lacks local ephemeral storage and GPU acceleration, necessitating external attached block storage for data persistence. High-speed networking capabilities are provided through a 30 Gbps baseline network bandwidth. Due to its large core count and proportional memory capacity, ecs.g5ne.16xlarge offers resource density for enterprise web applications, middleware, distributed cache clusters, and general backend computing tasks where local disk I/O is offloaded to remote cloud storage services.
